title: Complete a level and unlock the next level
description: Verifies a learner can start an unlocked level, answer questions with feedback, complete the level, and see the next level become unlocked after a reload.

steps.description: Fill in the registration email field with a unique valid email
Fill in the registration password field with a valid password
Answer the current question with a valid response
Proceed to the next question until the level ends
Verify a level completion confirmation is visible
Verify the next level is shown as unlocked on the level list

title: Log in and see learning progress with available levels
description: Verifies an existing learner can log in from the home page and see the authenticated interface showing levels and progress.

steps.description: Verify the user is in an authenticated state with a levels list displayed

title: Register new user and land in logged-in state
description: Verifies a new learner can register with valid details and immediately reach the authenticated experience with levels visible.

steps.description: Fill learner_{{RANDOM}} into the username field
Fill learner_{{RANDOM}}@example.com into the email field
Fill ValidPass123! into the password field
Verify the user is logged in and a levels list is displayed

title: Browse levels and start an unlocked level
description: Verifies a logged-in learner can view locked vs unlocked levels on the home page and start an unlocked level to see the first question.

steps.description: Select an unlocked level from the levels list
Verify the level view opens and the first question is displayed

title: Resume progress as a returning learner and continue to the next unlocked level
description: Verifies a learner can log in, see prior progress reflected on the level list, and start the next unlocked level.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify a question is displayed for the started level

title: Validate empty answer submission within a level
description: Verifies submitting an empty answer shows a validation message and prevents progressing until a valid answer is provided.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the answer without providing a response
Verify an answer validation error is visible
Provide a valid answer to the question
Verify correct or incorrect feedback is displayed

title: Get help from AI Tutor while in a level
description: Verifies a learner can open the AI Tutor, submit a question during gameplay, and see a response in the widget.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Type a question about the current exercise into the tutor input
Verify an AI Tutor response is displayed

title: Answer multiple choice and fill-in-the-blank questions with feedback
description: Verifies a learner can interact with multiple question types, submit answers, receive immediate feedback, and continue through questions.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
If the question is multiple choice, select an answer option
If the question is fill-in-the-blank, fill a non-empty answer into the input field
Verify correct or incorrect feedback is displayed
Verify the next question is displayed

title: Advance to the next question after submitting an answer
description: Verifies that after submitting an answer and receiving feedback, the learner can proceed to the next question in the level.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Answer the current question with a valid response
Verify a different question is displayed than before

title: Create a new level in the admin panel
description: Verifies an administrator can create a new level and see it appear in the admin level list.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Click the link to open the admin panel
Fill a unique level title into the title field
Fill valid metadata into required fields
Verify the new level appears in the admin level list

title: Add multiple question types to a level in admin
description: Verifies an administrator can add a multiple-choice and a fill-in-the-blank question to a level and see both listed for that level.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Click the link to open the admin panel
Create a new level with a unique title
Open the newly created level's details
Fill valid multiple-choice question content and answer options
Fill valid fill-in-the-blank prompt and expected answer
Verify both newly added questions are listed under the level

title: Prevent starting a locked level from the level list
description: Verifies a learner cannot start a locked level from the home level list.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Locate a level shown as locked
Attempt to start the locked level
Verify the locked level does not open into gameplay

title: Delete a question from a level in admin with confirmation
description: Verifies an administrator can delete a question from a level after confirming and the question is removed from the list.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Click the link to open the admin panel
Create a new level with a unique title
Open the newly created level's details
Add a new question with valid content
Verify the deleted question is no longer shown in the question list

title: Validate email format during registration
description: Verifies registration blocks submission with an invalid email format and displays an email validation error.

steps.description: Fill learner_{{RANDOM}} into the username field
Fill invalid-email into the email field
Fill ValidPass123! into the password field
Verify an email format validation error is visible and the user is not registered/logged in

title: Reject login with incorrect credentials
description: Verifies a learner attempting to log in with an incorrect password remains unauthenticated and sees a login failure indication.

steps.description: Fill invalid-password into the password field
Verify a login error is visible and the user remains unauthenticated
